items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I made some recordings with B. B. King. He would call me in to, I wasn‘t with his group or anything, but he would call me in to record with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, so anyway how about, I‘m thinking of somebody else. How about B. B. King, you recorded with B. B. King.
Yeah, I made some recordings with B. B. King. He would call me in to, I wasn‘t with his group or anything, but he would call me in to record with him. And I did that
two or three times, I don‘t know how many times I did, but I did it more than once. B. B. King, I recorded with him.
